description: ⚠️⚠️ the amounts are no longer rounded to the cent: an order paid to the last cent reads as still owing a fraction of one, and somebody chases a customer who owes nothing
⚠️ an unreadable amount becomes NaN instead of nothing: one bad row makes every figure on the order unreadable from then on
paid nothing and paid half become the same state: chasing a customer who has paid nothing and one who has paid half is the same conversation again
find: if (paid <= 0) return { paid, outstanding, state: due <= 0 ? "paid" : "unpaid" };
replace: if (paid <= 0) return { paid, outstanding, state: due <= 0 ? "paid" : "partial" };

description: ⚠️ a zero or negative amount can be recorded as a payment: a refund entered as a negative payment makes the total say something that never happened
